trigger: I am being threatened or beaten in custody
description: What to do if you are being harmed, threatened, or degraded while detained.

steps.text: Do not sign any statement obtained through threats or violence.
Remember: torture and inhuman or degrading treatment are prohibited (s.34).
Ask to see a lawyer and to receive medical attention.
If you can, remember or record the names of those involved and the time.
Report the abuse to the National Human Rights Commission.
Contact a lawyer or the Legal Aid Council as soon as possible.

citations.source_name: 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
